candidates.reason: The official AnimatableGaussians schema differs from the MMLP-Human NPZ consumer schema.

candidates.topology_leakage_risk: Weights bind to a specific template or Gaussian point set unless recomputed after topology changes.

candidates.method: Closest SMPL-X triangle plus barycentric interpolation of official SMPL-X vertex LBS weights.

candidates.determinism_gate: Generate twice in isolated staging and require equal schema, arrays, bounds, and canonical content hash.
candidates.topology_independence: The continuous grid is generated from fixed SMPL-X topology and queried at the actual initial Gaussian positions.

gaussian_lifecycle.clone_split_densification_in_current_tra: ABSENT; the audited train.py and GaussianModel have a fixed initialized point set.
gaussian_lifecycle.future_topology_change_rule: Any clone/split/densification or point replacement must explicitly rebind weights and version the checkpoint schema.
gaussian_lifecycle.initialization_source: Poisson-disk sampling of the accepted canonical template mesh
gaussian_lifecycle.weight_materialization: First get_weights query interpolates the grid at _xyz and caches the result.

generation_gate_for_next_task: Pin the exact neutral SMPL-X hash and PointInterpolant source/build hash.
Generate only in private staging, never in raw root until validation passes.
Require finite nonnegative weights, row sums near one, expected joint count, valid bbox, and exact required NPZ keys.
Query template vertices and representative interior/exterior points; reject discontinuities or NaN/Inf.
Run isolated duplicate generation or a stronger deterministic equivalence test before promotion.
Promote once to gaussian/lbs_weights_grid.npz with append-only provenance and no raw RGB/mask writes.

mmlp_consumer_contract.checkpoint_behavior: GaussianModel.capture stores materialized per-Gaussian _weights; restore consumes stored _weights.
mmlp_consumer_contract.runtime_query: torch.nn.functional.grid_sample with xyz-to-zyx permutation, border padding, align_corners=True

recommended_route.official_volume_role: Cross-check only unless an explicit deterministic schema adapter is separately reviewed.
recommended_route.reason: It produces the exact current consumer schema, avoids binding weights to one loose-clothing mesh topology, and queries the actual Gaussian initialization positions.
